verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a mobile SSH/Mosh terminal and code client, so an AI agent that reviews pull requests is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence documents no built-in AI agent, PR analysis, or code-suggestion capability. Running an agent on a remote host over SSH, or through connected VS Code/Codespaces, would be a user-side or host-platform workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent analyze my pull requests and suggest code improvements from my phone
